notes: Motion vocab (CaseFilm): parallax(=bleed 2.5D), scan(=grid/scanning light), duotone(=navy mood drift), rack_focus, motion_graphics(=kinetic type/metaphor anim). Rotate methods; never repeat same method back-to-back; 0.35s crossfade overlap; Trail motion-blur on fast beats. Assembler = Claude; Codex only generates the ai_image stills (see EP31_unlock_ai_prompts.v001.md). factory footage = rights-cleared shelf only. No real-person likeness; no phone brand/OS UI.
